source_title: Delhi University student's Bhangra performance wins hearts months after being shared
source_excerpt:
A Delhi University student took centre stage at Lady Shri Ram College with a lively Bhangra performance that has now found a wider audience online.
A Delhi University student's energetic Punjabi folk dance performance at Lady Shri Ram College has delighted social media users as her video went viral months after being shared online.
The video was shared by Sana, a student of LSR, and featured her performing Bhangra and Gidda with another woman to Miss Pooja's Punjabi song Aashiq .
Dressed in kurta sets, both women danced enthusiastically to the track as the audience cheered and applauded their performance.
In the caption of her post, Sana credited her co-dancer who goes by the Instagram handle @team.shredds for helping her learn the dance steps in a short time.
"All thanks to @team.shredds (my co-dancer in frame) for teaching me a bit of Bhangra and Gidda in such a short time. I am in no manner trained in Punjabi folk dance, so bhool chukh maaf," she wrote in the caption.
Although Sana had originally posted the video in February, it began circulating widely on X on Thursday, bringing the performance back into the spotlight.

Social media users responded with encouraging comments, praising the duo's dance and their infectious energy. The video has gone viral with close to three million views on Instagram. - Ends
